mythology: Sati's left hand (or hip/waist) fell here; also where Indra performed repentance and worship of the Divine Mother to regain his divine throne.
pilgrimage_significance: Trikuta Kshetra: It is simultaneously a Shakti Peetha (Puruhutika), a Pada Gaya Tirtha for Pitru Shraddha, and the birthplace of Datta Avatar Sripada Srivallabha.
historical_notes: Celebrated in Brahma Purana and Guru Charitra; historical inscriptions describe endowments by Chalukyan and Kakatiya monarchs.
